alt: Thymus: a whole-body drawing locating the thymus behind the sternum above the heart, a light micrograph labelling cortex, medulla, trabeculae and fibrous capsule, and a schematic of one lobule labelling the fibrous capsule, cortex and medulla with thymocytes, cortical epithelial cells, medullary epithelial cells, dendritic cells, macrophages, trabecula and a blood vessel.
